mapper.sql: CASE p.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '전송' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '승인' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '반려' ELSE '전송' END
CONCAT(COALESCE(#{contextPath}, ''), '/branch/place_order/', CASE p.status WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'approval_detail.jsp' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 'rejection_detail.jsp' ELSE 'request_detail.jsp' END)
CASE WHEN p.status = 'PENDING' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(#{contextPath}, ''), '/branch/place_order/cancel_request.jsp') ELSE NULL END

p.po_id, p.po_no, p.branch_code, b.name AS branch_name, DATE_FORMAT(p.request_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at, p.total_material_cnt, p.total_amount, p.reject_reason, p.status AS status_code, AS status
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_order_detail d WHERE d.po_id = p.po_id) AS item_count, COALESCE( (SELECT CAST(SUM(d.requested_qty) AS SIGNED) FROM place_order_detail d WHERE d.po_id = p.po_id), 0 ) AS total_qty, NULL AS detail_url, NULL AS cancel_url FROM place_order p JOIN branch b ON b.branch_code = p.branch_code WHERE p.po_no = #{value}

SELECT pod.po_detail_id, pod.po_id, pod.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit, pod.requested_qty, pod.approved_qty, pod.remaining_qty
FROM place_order_detail pod JOIN material m ON m.material_code = pod.material_code JOIN place_order p ON p.po_id = pod.po_id WHERE p.po_no = #{value} ORDER BY pod.po_detail_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_order (po_no, branch_code, total_material_cnt, total_amount, reject_reason) VALUES (#{poNo}, #{branchCode}, #{totalMaterialCnt}, #{totalAmount}, #{rejectReason})

INSERT INTO place_order_detail (po_id, material_code, requested_qty, approved_qty, remaining_qty) VALUES
(#{poId}, #{detail.materialCode}, #{detail.requestedQty}, #{detail.approvedQty}, #{detail.remainingQty})
